lines.en: label yasuspring6:
scene yasuamichurch1
I said to thee — o demons, wait. I’m worth your weight in gold.
lines.zh: 我对你们说——哦，众恶魔，且慢。我值得与你们等重的黄金。

lines.en: Ten thousand stone (not jade or slate), and more when you’re alone.
lines.zh: 一万石的重量（非玉非板岩），而当你独处时，还要更多。

lines.en: Chameleon, chamele-out. In pages like a leaf.
lines.zh: 变色龙，变色——出。像叶子一样夹在书页里。

lines.en: I’m asleep within my past mistakes. I am pressed between new sheets.
lines.zh: 我睡在自己过往的错误里。我被压在新的床单之间。

lines.en: {size=-6}There’s something intriguing about the drip-drop-drip of angels’ tears as they avoid the unmarked graves that grant us air and wind up, almost mysteriously, bent into the same elongated rectangles that dampen our footsteps to keep us from knowing when we’re too close or too far from points A, B, and C.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-6}天使的泪水滴——答——滴，避开那些无名的坟墓——那些赋予我们空气的坟墓——最终几乎神秘地弯成同样细长的长方形，闷住我们的脚步声，好让我们不知道自己离 A、B、C 三点到底是太近还是太远。这其中有某种耐人寻味的东西。{/size}

lines.en: I come to you now, purer than I’ve been in ages, with tales from a world without erosion. A half-circle hidden behind three full ones above us, not knowing I’m in decimals. It’s a feeling infinitesimal.
lines.zh: 我现在来到你面前，比多年来任何时候都纯净，带着一个没有侵蚀的世界的故事。一个半圆藏在我们头顶三个整圆之后，不知道我用的是小数。这是一种无穷小的感觉。

lines.en: {size=-2}The kind you don’t know unless you’re told that you do, so you believe when you are because there are no phases in the lifespan of “weren’t” that make you feel quite as smart as a single well-placed anecdote ever could.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}那种你不被告知、就不知道自己拥有的感觉——所以别人告诉你时你就信了，因为「不曾」的生命周期里，没有任何阶段能让你觉得自己像一句恰到好处的轶事那样聪明。{/size}

lines.en: The first time I tasted the body of Christ was at the site of his crucifixion.
lines.zh: 我第一次尝到基督的身体，是在他受难的地方。

lines.en: We all gathered around to measure his feet after the second Mary commented on their immaculacy to us over what we didn’t know at the time would be our second to last supper.
lines.zh: 我们聚在一起，量他的脚——在第二个 Mary 对我们品评它们有多无瑕之后，就在那顿我们当时还不知道会是倒数第二顿的晚餐上。

lines.en: I still remember the texture of his fallen thorns and how they stuck between my teeth — a sensation so curious that I became furious and couldn’t help but tell the Pilate on the flight back to Judaea.
lines.zh: 我还记得他落下的荆棘的质感，它们怎么卡在我的牙缝里——那感觉奇特到让我勃然大怒，忍不住在飞回 Judaea 的航班上告诉了那个 Pilate。

lines.en: By the time the fourth cup of wine made its way to me, however, I had more than enough blood in my system. So I bent over backwards and asked to be made into letters as well.
lines.zh: 然而等第四杯酒传到我手上时，我体内已经有够多的血了。于是我向后弯下腰，请求也把我变成字母。

lines.en: {size=-2}That’s why we can talk now. I’ve achieved a state of being so permanently in-review that I can mold myself into whatever you need to see or hear or think and you can’t tell me I’m wrong because you’re still dressed in weren’t.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}这就是为什么我们现在能说话。我达成了一种「永久处于审阅中」的存在状态，可以把自己塑造成你需要看见、听见或想到的任何样子；而你不能说我错了，因为你还穿着「不曾」。{/size}

lines.en: Be consumed by my current.
lines.zh: 被我的水流吞没吧。

lines.en: I am strength.
lines.zh: 我是力量。

lines.en: I’m emergent.
lines.zh: 我正在涌现。

lines.en: Yasu Yasui stands before my duplicated corpse and the symbol of my sacrifice. This is not the site of the thorned one. There are far too few flavors for that and the epilogue is still a world away.
lines.zh: Yasu Yasui 站在我被复制的尸体和我的牺牲象征之前。这里不是那位戴荆棘者的受难地。这儿的味道太少，而尾声还隔着整个世界。

lines.en: : Blessed be those who give up their eyes.
lines.zh: : 舍弃双眼的人有福了。

lines.en: : Who give up their mouths. Who give up their lives.
lines.zh: : 交出嘴巴的人。交出生命的人。

lines.en: : Blessed be those who dream in the pew.
lines.zh: : 那些在长椅上做梦的人有福了。

lines.en: : Who see in the dark.
lines.zh: : 在黑暗中看见的人。

lines.en: : Who look just like you.
lines.zh: : 长得像你的人。

lines.en: : Uhh...hello?
lines.zh: : 呃……你好？

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch2
: My, my...what a pleasant surprise.
lines.zh: : 哎呀哎呀……真是意外的惊喜。

lines.en: : It’s like every day, my dreams move one step closer to reality now.
lines.zh: : 就好像每一天，我的梦都离现实更近一步。

lines.en: : I had a feeling you would be here. None of the other churches looked creepy enough.
lines.zh: : 我就有种感觉你会在这儿。别的教堂都不够阴森。

lines.en: : To what do I owe the pleasure, child of light? And why, may I ask, have you finally come?
lines.zh: : 是什么风把你吹来了，光之子？还有，我能问问吗，你为什么终于来了？

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch3
: I found a flier near the market by my house and wanted to come get a taste of salvation instead of tomatoes. Where is everyone?
lines.zh: : 我在我家附近的市场边上捡到一张传单，想来尝尝救赎的味道，而不是番茄的。大家都去哪儿了？

lines.en: : This {i}is{/i} everyone. And oh, how delighted I am to know that my fliers are finally working.
lines.zh: : 这{i}就是{/i}「大家」。哦，得知我的传单终于起效了，我有多高兴啊。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch4
: It’d help if you put an address on them and not just the name of your church. This place doesn’t show up on GPS, you know. It goes by some other name and is marked as “permanently closed.”
lines.zh: : 你要是在上面写个地址、而不是只写教堂名字，会好办得多。这地方 GPS 上搜不到，你知道吗。它挂在别的名字下，还标着「永久停业」。

lines.en: : It is up to Him to guide lost souls here, for He is the shepherd and I am but one proactive little lamb. I can “baaah” and bleat all day long, but I can never shear myself.
lines.zh: : 指引迷途的灵魂来这儿是祂的事——因为祂是牧羊人，而我不过是一只积极主动的小羊。我可以整天「咩——」地叫，但我永远没法给自己剪毛。

lines.en: : So you just...wait here all by yourself for someone to show up every day? Isn’t that lonely?
lines.zh: : 所以你就……每天一个人在这儿等着有人上门？不孤独吗？

lines.en: : The voices and the rabbits keep me company. And while their presence isn’t the same as it once was, it’s important for me to remain hopeful. For it is {i}hope{/i} itself that brought you here.
lines.zh: : 有声音和兔子陪我。虽然它们不像从前那么常在，但保持希望对我很重要。因为正是{i}希望{/i}本身把你带到了这里。

lines.en: : Do you truly wish to taste salvation? To be saved before this is all no more? Because He can help you if you do. And I can show you {i}how.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你真的想尝尝救赎吗？想在这一切化为乌有之前被拯救吗？如果你想，祂能帮你。而我告诉你{i}怎么做{/i}。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch5
: I...don’t know, really.
lines.zh: : 我……其实也不知道。

lines.en: : I believe in God. But I’ve never known what God {i}is.{/i} And my mom, she...
lines.zh: : 我相信上帝。可我从来不知道上帝{i}是什么{/i}。而我妈妈，她……

lines.en: : I think she believed in...something close to {i}this.{/i} There were things in a box of her belongings that looked a lot like your ads. So I figured I...might as well come down and see what this is all about.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她信的是……跟{i}这个{/i}很接近的东西。她的遗物箱里有东西，跟你这些广告长得特别像。所以我想……不如就来一趟，看看这到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch6
: You worship some sort of...{i}light.{/i} Don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你们崇拜某种……{i}光{/i}。对吧？

lines.en: : Light is the apple. What I worship is the tree.
lines.zh: : 光是苹果。我崇拜的是树。

lines.en: : You and I are just fruit, you see. The kind one eats off the ground for we will never be as special as those who grow on branches.
lines.zh: : 你和我不过是果实，你瞧。是那种从地上捡起来吃的——因为我们永远比不上长在枝头的那些。

lines.en: : Kind of...demeaning. But I guess that’s par for the course for a religion that, and correct me if I’m wrong here, treats females as beings who need to be ejaculated inside of in order to be saved?
lines.zh: : 有点……贬低人。不过对一门宗教来说也算正常吧——要是我说错了请更正——它把女性当成必须被射在里面才能得到拯救的存在？

lines.en: : That is mostly correct, yes.
lines.zh: : 大体正确，是的。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch7
: Neat. And what are your policies on incest?
lines.zh: : 不错。那你们对乱伦是什么政策？

lines.en: : It is sinful and impure.
lines.zh: : 那是罪恶且不洁的。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch8
: Yeah, on second thought, I don’t know if this is going to work out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，再想想，我觉得这事儿成不了。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch9
: Hm?

: Even God’s rulebook is not without a long list of clauses. And your situation as a very particular apple who has fallen from a very particular tree would certainly allow a return to your origin point.
lines.zh: : 就连上帝的规矩本，也少不了一长串但书。而你的处境，作为从一棵非常特别的树上落下的一颗非常特别的苹果，确实允许你回到自己的原点。

lines.en: : Meaning...that my dad is special and your god will let me have a bunch of sex with him?
lines.zh: : 意思是……我爸爸很特别，而你的神会允许我跟他大干特干？

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch10
: See! It is not so hard to understand at all! Yet this very concept seems to perplex so many of our peers! I knew you would be special, Ami! I just knew it!
lines.zh: : 看！这根本不难理解嘛！可偏偏这个概念把我们那么多同龄人都难住了！我就知道你会是特别的，Ami！我就是知道！

lines.en: : You...you did? Then how come you’ve never really, like...tried to recruit me the way you have everybody else? I had to go out of my way to come to {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你……你早就知道？那为什么{i}你{/i}从来没有像对别人那样，真的……来拉我入伙？我还得自己找上门来。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch11
: In this house, we all do as we’re told.
lines.zh: : 在这座屋子里，我们都照吩咐行事。

lines.en: : I am far closer to an ant than I am a missionary. Such things keep the latter pure to ensure that transference goes as smoothly and pleasurably as possible for both parties.
lines.zh: : 我离一只蚂蚁，比离一个传教士近得多。这样的事能保住后者的纯洁，好让「传递」对双方都尽可能顺遂愉悦。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
scene yasuamichurch12
: And if the man who needs to do that in order to save me vehemently refuses, what then? Do I just unceremoniously die and that’s that?
lines.zh: : 要是那个为了救我必须这么做的人死活不肯，那怎么办？我就这么无声无息地死去，然后就完了？

lines.en: : There is no “death” in this world, child of light — just a different room for those who those who couldn’t find the first.
lines.zh: : 这个世界里没有「死亡」，光之子——只有另一间屋子，留给那些找不到第一间的人。

lines.en: : You can’t {i}make{/i} him save me, then?
lines.zh: : 那你不能{i}让{/i}他来救我咯？

lines.en: : Only He can make anyone do {i}anything.{/i} And if it is salvation you seek, surely He would not overlook someone as special as you.
lines.zh: : 只有祂能让任何人做{i}任何事{/i}。如果你寻求的是救赎，祂肯定不会忽略像你这样特别的人。

lines.en: : Yeah, surely. What makes {i}me{/i} special, though?
lines.zh: : 是啊，肯定。不过{i}我{/i}到底特别在哪儿呢？

lines.en: : What do you see in me that no one else does, Yasu? And what do you see in my dad?
lines.zh: : 你在我身上看到了什么别人没看到的东西，Yasu？你在我爸爸身上又看到了什么？

lines.en: : There are fliers all over our neighborhood and I’ve barely even seen them anywhere else. Why are you so desperate to appeal to {i}us?{/i} Is it really just because God is telling you to?
lines.zh: : {i}我们{/i}小区到处都是传单，别的地方我几乎没见过。你为什么这么急着讨好我们？真的只是因为上帝叫你这么做的吗？

lines.en: else:
scene yasuamichurch13
: Sign me the heck up then. I’ve experienced “transference” so many times now that they’re going to have to make a brand new Heaven just for me.
lines.zh: : 那就赶紧给我报名吧。「传递」我经历了太多次了，他们得专门为我造一个全新的天堂。

lines.en: : I can tell. His scent clings to you like sin does to the dark.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。祂的气味黏在你身上，就像罪黏在黑暗上。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch14
: Thank you. I am very proud of that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我为此非常自豪。

lines.en: : As you should be! For it is the first step of many, but still one that so few dare to take.
lines.zh: : 你理应如此！因为这是众多步骤里的第一步，却依然是极少有人敢迈出的一步。

lines.en: : And if you are anything like Sensei, then surely your role in this story is far greater than even mine.
lines.zh: : 而如果你跟 Sensei 有哪怕一点相像，那你在这个故事里的角色，肯定比我还要重要得多。

lines.en: : The black sheep is the most beautiful of them all, Ami. So beautiful, in fact, that it scares away the white ones who fail to understand the contrast between difference and deference.
lines.zh: : 黑羊是所有羊里最美的，Ami。美到会把那些白色赶跑——因为它们搞不懂「不同」和「顺从」之间的差别。

lines.en: : That’s why He wants you. {i}Both{/i} of you.
lines.zh: : 所以祂想要你。想要你们{i}两个{/i}。

lines.en: : You’re full of colors that no one else has. Colors that would surely spill from you when cut open! Yet you’ve selfishly imprisoned them and-
lines.zh: : 你身上装满了别人没有的颜色。切开时必定会从你身上泼洒出来的颜色！可你却自私地把它们囚禁起来，而且——

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch15
: Yasu? Is something wrong? You stopped complimenting me all of a sudden and I would like you to start again from the top if that’s-
lines.zh: : Yasu？怎么了？你突然不夸我了，我想让你从头再来一遍，要是——

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch16
: A game!
lines.zh: : 游戏！

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : A game! We must play a game! It’s the perfect introduction!
lines.zh: : 游戏！我们必须玩个游戏！这是最完美的入门！

lines.en: : We’ll consult with the Book of Colors to find out how your insides look! Then, you’ll know exactly how special you are without being forced to listen to the input of a lowly foot-soldier!
lines.zh: : 我们会去查《色彩之书》，看看你的内在长什么样！这样你就能确切知道自己有多特别，还不用被迫听一个低等步兵的意见！

lines.en: : I mean...I’m sort of in your hands right now so, if that’s what you think is best, I’m all for it. Why do you need to keep putting yourself down, though?
lines.zh: : 我意思是……我现在反正任你摆布，所以你要是觉得这样最好，我完全赞成。不过你为什么总要把自己贬得那么低呢？

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch17
: Down?...
: There’s nothing wrong with being a foot-soldier. And there’s nothing wrong with being an {i}ant.{/i} So it hurts to see you talking down on yourself like that when I know you’re trying so hard.
lines.zh: : 当步兵没什么不好。当{i}蚂蚁{/i}也没什么不好。所以看到你这么贬低自己，我很难受——我知道你已经很努力了。

lines.en: : Yasu-
lines.zh: : Yasu——

lines.en: : You would understand if you knew how {i}big{/i} He is. You would know that we are {i}all{/i} but ants in comparison. And that it {i}is{/i} bad to be one.
lines.zh: : 你要{i}是{/i}知道祂有多{i}大{/i}，你就会懂。你就会知道，相比之下我们{i}都{/i}不过是蚂蚁。而做蚂蚁是坏的。

lines.en: : That is how great the divide is, Ami. And I promise you will know in time.
lines.zh: : 那道鸿沟就是这么大，Ami。我保证，你迟早会知道。

lines.en: : Well...okay, but-
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧，不过——

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch16
: I’LL GO GET THE BOOK!
lines.zh: : 我去拿书！

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch18
: I...guess I will go sit down then?
lines.zh: : 那……我就先坐下等咯？

lines.en: scene black
scene yasuamichurch19
: Okay! Just one more question and we’re all done.
lines.zh: : 好！只剩最后一题，我们就全做完了。

lines.en: : Have my answers been, like...okay so far? Because I never get the results I want on personality quizzes and I’m starting to think the problem is just me.
lines.zh: : 我的答案到目前为止……还行吗？因为我做性格测试从来拿不到想要的结果，我开始觉得问题出在我身上。

lines.en: : You’re doing wonderful, I think. But I have only done this a handful of times and I can’t fathom a guess of where you’ll end up on the color wheel.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你做得非常好。不过我只做过几次，猜不出你最后会落在色轮的哪个位置。

lines.en: : Do you know {i}your{/i} color, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 你知道{i}自己{/i}的颜色吗，Yasu？

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch20
: Of course I do. It’s 74d9e9.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。是 74d9e9。

lines.en: : Is that the hex code?! The results are that comprehensive?!
lines.zh: : 那是十六进制色号？！结果详细到这种程度吗？！

lines.en: : They {i}must{/i} be, otherwise we’d end with too many perfect pairs and it would make Him jealous.
lines.zh: : {i}必须{/i}如此，否则我们会得到太多完美的一对，那会让祂嫉妒。

lines.en: : It isn’t often he sees color at all. So when he {i}does,{/i} it’s important he sees as many as possible.
lines.zh: : 祂并不常看见颜色。所以{i}一旦{/i}看见，重要的是让祂看到尽可能多。

lines.en: : Is it weird that I’m starting to get a little nervous? Like, what if it’s not a color I like? At least if it were something vague like “blue” I could just pick a shade I enjoy.
lines.zh: : 我开始有点紧张，这算奇怪吗？万一不是我喜欢的颜色呢？至少要是「蓝色」这种笼统的说法，我还能挑一个自己喜欢的色调。

lines.en: : I promise you will like the answer. Everyone {i}always{/i} likes the answer.
lines.zh: : 我保证你会喜欢这个答案。每个人{i}总是{/i}喜欢自己的答案。

lines.en: : But...didn’t you just say you’ve only done this a handful of-
lines.zh: : 可是……你刚才不是说你只做过几——

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch19
: Final question — what would your perfect world be like?
lines.zh: : 最后一题——你心中完美的世界是什么样的？

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch21
: You may take all the time you need. I, too, think this is the hardest question on the quiz!
lines.zh: : 你想多久都可以。我也觉得这是测验里最难的一题！

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch22
: No...it’s not {i}that{/i} hard. I was just a little surprised to hear something so {i}grand{/i} when all of the other questions have been super weird and specific.
lines.zh: : 不……没{i}那么{/i}难。我只是有点意外：前面所有问题都超级怪、超级具体，突然来一个这么{i}宏大{/i}的。

lines.en: : My perfect world is just one where I’m happy. It’s that simple, really.
lines.zh: : 我完美的世界，就是一个我幸福的世界。真的就那么简单。

lines.en: : You’re not happy here?
lines.zh: : 你在这里不幸福吗？

lines.en: : Are {i}you{/i} happy here?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}在这里幸福吗？

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it be so much better to have the rest of the seats filled too? To have everyone believe in the same things you do? And not think you’re crazy for just being a little different?
lines.zh: : 要是剩下的座位也能坐满，不是好得多吗？要是每个人都相信你所相信的东西呢？不会因为只是有点不同就被当成疯子？

lines.en: : Happiness is really what matters most at the end of the day. And we only get {i}one{/i} life, so if we’re unable to find such a simple thing within it, then what’s even the point?
lines.zh: : 到头来，幸福才是最要紧的。而我们只有{i}一次{/i}生命，所以要是连这么简单的东西都找不到，那还有什么意义？

lines.en: : Your answer has been recorded! Now please wait one moment while I calculate the results.
lines.zh: : 你的答案已记录！请稍等片刻，我来计算结果。

lines.en: : Take as much time as you need. We’ve got plenty of it.
lines.zh: : 你慢慢来。我们有的是时间。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch23
: Your color is ff4dd2.
lines.zh: : 你的颜色是 ff4dd2。

lines.en: : Oh. That took literally no time at all.
lines.zh: : 哦。这可真是一点时间都没花。

lines.en: : I had a feeling that’s what it would be before we started. Your hue is rather blinding in the glow of the chapel.
lines.zh: : 在开始之前我就有种感觉会是这个。你的色调在教堂的光辉里相当刺眼。

lines.en: : Can you text that to me, by any chance? There’s no way I’m going to remember it.
lines.zh: : 你能不能用短信发给我？我肯定记不住。

lines.en: : Including the color of one’s light in a mobile message is a third-level sin that I’d need to give up two of my fingernails for. I can send you a postcard, though.
lines.zh: : 把一个人光的颜色写进手机短信，是三级罪，我得为此交出两片指甲。不过我可以给你寄张明信片。

lines.en: : If that lets you keep your fingernails, sure.
lines.zh: : 只要能让你保住指甲，行。

lines.en: : You mentioned your mother earlier. Tell me more about her.
lines.zh: : 你刚才提到了你母亲。多跟我说说她吧。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch24
: N...Now? Why? You’ve had all night to ask.
lines.zh: : 现……现在？为什么？你有一整晚可以问啊。

lines.en: : I did not ask because I already knew. I’ve realized with Touka’s help that such a thing is impolite, though. And I’m trying to remember to ask people more personal questions since that is how one makes friends.
lines.zh: : 我没问，是因为我已经知道了。不过在 Touka 的帮助下，我意识到那样不礼貌。而我在努力记住多问别人一些私人问题，因为那是交朋友的方式。

lines.en: : What do you mean you already knew? Is this one of those “premonition” things of yours that I’ve been hearing about? Because I thought those were all about stuff that hasn’t happened yet.
lines.zh: : 你说你已经知道了，是什么意思？是我听说的那种「预感」之类的东西吗？我以为那些都是针对还没发生的事。

lines.en: : You’re both right and wrong all at once.
lines.zh: : 你既对又错，同时都有。

lines.en: : Everything that has already happened will surely happen again. And everything that has yet to happen has already happened once. Just as things that are currently happening are also {i}not{/i} happening at all!
lines.zh: : 所有已经发生过的事，必定会再发生一次。而所有还没发生的事，都已经发生过一次了。正如正在发生的事，同时也根本{i}没有{/i}发生！

lines.en: : It’s all very confusing, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 很让人糊涂，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, but surprisingly relatable regardless.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但意外地有共鸣。

lines.en: : She was an interesting woman, wasn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她是个有趣的女人吧？

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch25
: Far more than just “interesting.”
lines.zh: : 远不止「有趣」。

lines.en: : She was talented and beautiful. And her {i}voice...{/i}It was so sweet that I can still hear it in my dreams after all this time.
lines.zh: : 她有才华，又漂亮。而她的{i}声音{/i}……那么甜，时至今日我还能在梦里听见。

lines.en: : No one saw the world like her. No one ever {i}will.{/i} Not even me...no matter how much I may try to.
lines.zh: : 没有人像她那样看这个世界。永远不{i}会{/i}有人。连我也不行……不管我多努力。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch26

: After I was born, she found God. But not long after that, she started to lose herself. Started hearing things. {i}Seeing{/i} things. Things no one else believed, but things that were {i}very{/i} real.
lines.zh: : 我出生之后，她找到了上帝。但那之后不久，她开始失去自我。开始听见东西。{i}看见{/i}东西。那些没人相信的东西，却是{i}非常{/i}真实的东西。

lines.en: : Is that how it is for you, Yasu? Does it ever get...exhausting? Living in what’s essentially a different plane of existence from everyone else?
lines.zh: : 你也是这样吗，Yasu？会不会觉得……累？活在一个本质上跟所有人不同的位面里？

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch27
: Exhausting?...
: I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : I have always been this way. The only difference is who the burden I am has shifted to.
lines.zh: : 我一直都是这样。唯一的区别是，我这份负担转移到了谁身上。

lines.en: : My world has always been {i}wrong{/i} in the eyes of others, but it’s everything {i}else{/i} that’s wrong to me.
lines.zh: : 在别人眼里，我的世界一直是{i}错的{/i}；但对我来说，错的恰恰是{i}其他一切{/i}。

lines.en: : Yet, everyone says I must change...
lines.zh: : 然而每个人都说我必须改变……

lines.en: : I think {i}that{/i} is what is exhausting, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我想，累的是{i}这个{/i}吧，Ami。

lines.en: : People wanted my mom to change too. Heck, there’s a girl living in my house right now that tells {i}me{/i} I need to change every single day. But who we are is up to us, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 别人也想让我妈妈改变。见鬼，现在就有个女孩住在我家里，天天跟{i}我{/i}说我需要改变。可我们是谁，是我们自己说了算的，不是吗？

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch28
: Not me. Who I am is up to Him. I’m not even allowed to read most of the manga Molly recommends to me.
lines.zh: : 我不行。我是谁，由祂说了算。Molly 推荐给我的大部分漫画，我甚至都不准看。

lines.en: : Oh, right.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。

lines.en: : Or masturbate. I can’t do that either.
lines.zh: : 或者自慰。那个也不行。

lines.en: : Yeah. That was one of the very first things I learned about you.
lines.zh: : 嗯。那是我最早了解到的关于你的事情之一。

lines.en: : It’s so hard being free of sin. But if that is the price I must pay to avoid abandonment, so be it. God is the only one who has never forsaken me, and so I shan’t leave his side no matter what.
lines.zh: : 摆脱罪恶太难了。但如果这是我不被抛弃必须付的代价，那就这样吧。上帝是唯一一个从未离弃我的人，所以无论发生什么，我都不会离开祂身边。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch29
: You know...you’re actually really cute, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……你其实真的挺可爱的，Yasu。

lines.en: : No I’m not. I can’t even brush my hair correctly. Touka must do it for me.
lines.zh: : 不，我不可爱。我连头发都梳不好。得让 Touka 帮我梳。

lines.en: : A different kind of cute. Like the kind a person wants to protect.
lines.zh: : 是另一种可爱。就是那种让人想保护的可爱。

lines.en: : Your god is very lucky to have you.
lines.zh: : 你的神有你，很幸运。

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch30
: He’ll be lucky to have you too! For something tells me this is far from your last time coming here. You’ll be back, won’t you?
lines.zh: : 有你，祂也会很幸运！因为我有种感觉，这绝不是你最后一次来这儿。你会回来的，对吧？

lines.en: : Is that okay? Because, if it’s not trouble, I {i}would{/i} like to learn more.
lines.zh: : 可以吗？因为如果不麻烦的话，我{i}想{/i}多了解一些。

lines.en: : If this is what my mom believed in, I want to at least know what she {i}saw.{/i} Because that’s the one thing I’ve just never been able to figure out.
lines.zh: : 如果这就是我妈妈信的东西，我至少想知道她{i}看见{/i}了什么。因为那是我唯一始终弄不明白的事。

lines.en: : If that’s what you want, I can tell you right now!
lines.zh: : 如果你想要，我现在就可以告诉你！

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch31
: You {i}can?{/i} How?
lines.zh: : 你{i}可以{/i}？怎么做？

lines.en: : Give me your hand...
lines.zh: : 把手给我……

lines.en: scene black
scene yasuamichurch32
: Girls are special in His all-seeing blindness. And I’ve been granted the ability to carry their message and deliver it unto those who need it most.
lines.zh: : 女孩在祂全视的盲目中是特别的。而我被赋予了承载她们的信息、并传递给最需要的人的能力。

lines.en: : But...this is {i}my{/i} hand we’re talking about. So even if something like this lets you, like...see into a person’s mind or whatever, it’s not like you’re communicating with my mom. It’s just me.
lines.zh: : 可是……这是说{i}我的{/i}手啊。就算这种事能让你……看进一个人的脑子里什么的，你也不是在跟我妈交流。只是我。

lines.en: : Yes, but you’re your mother’s daughter. Just like your father is-
lines.zh: : 是的，但你是你母亲的女儿。就像你父亲是——

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch33
: ...Yasu?
lines.zh: : ……Yasu？

lines.en: : Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : What do you see?
lines.zh: : 你看见了什么？

lines.en: : Get out.
lines.zh: : 出去。

lines.en: : What? But-
lines.zh: : 什么？可是——

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch34
: {b}GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT!!!!!!! AAAAHHHHHH!!!!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去！！！！！！！啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！{/b}

lines.en: : Okay...
scene black
: I’m leaving...
lines.zh: : 我走了……

lines.en: scene yasuamichurch35
: I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : You must have seen something terrible.
lines.zh: : 你一定是看见了什么可怕的东西。

lines.en: : I really didn’t mean to scare you. And I will leave you alone now.
lines.zh: : 我真的不是故意吓你。我现在就走，不打扰你了。

lines.en: : {b}OUT!!!!!! GET OUT!!!!!!!! GO AWAY!!!!!!!!! GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT GET OUT!!!!!!!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}出去！！！！滚出去！！！！！！走开！！！！！！出去出去出去出去出去出去出去出去！！！！！！！{/b}

lines.en: : Thank you for today.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你今天陪我。

lines.en: scene black
: You don’t need to send me my color.
lines.zh: : 你不用把我的颜色发给我了。

lines.en: : But I’d love if you could send me yours.
lines.zh: : 但如果你愿意把你的发给我，我会很高兴。

lines.en: : I have a feeling it’s beautiful.
lines.zh: : 我有种感觉，它很美。
